newsitem.title: USA: AT&T sees Q2 results in line with estimates.
newsitem.headline: AT&T sees Q2 results in line with estimates.

text.p: Long distance telephone company AT&T said on Wednesday it expected its financial results for the second quarter to come within the range of analysts' estimates.
According to First Call's consensus of 24 analysts, the company's earings are expected to hit $0.58 per share.

In addition, AT&T said in a statement it expected to release the results on July 21. The statement accompanied a surprise announcement late Wednesday that AT&T's president would resign from the company after its board of directors declined to appoint him chief executive officer.
